name: Game Market (Tokyo)
blurb: Japan's largest tabletop and board-game market, where hundreds of designers and small publishers sell their own games directly to attendees.

editions.evidence: Official overview page (gamemarket.jp/access): '開催日 (Dates) 2026年10月17日（土）11:00～18:00 2026年10月18日（日）11:00～17:00 会場 (Venue) 幕張メッセ展示ホール 1・2・3・4・5'.

notes: This is a market-style event (circles/small publishers sell their own games at booths) with no celebrity guest program, so guests is 'none'. The venue, Makuhari Messe, is technically in Chiba (Mihama-ku, Chiba City), not Tokyo proper, though the event is widely called just 'Game Market' in English; this file is labelled '(Tokyo)' only to distinguish it from the separate Osaka/Kansai file. The official site states Game Market runs 3 times a year (Tokyo in spring and autumn, the Kansai region in winter); a Tokyo Spring 2027 edition is expected but had no announced dates yet as of this check.
